args.stdin: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_families pf JOIN product_variants pv ON pf.product_family_id = pv.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp1 ON pv.product_sku = pvp1.product_sku AND pvp1.property_key = 'screw type' AND pvp1.property_value_text = 'wood screw' JOIN product_variant_properties pvp2 ON pv.product_sku = pvp2.product_sku AND pvp2.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp2.property_value_text = '6 mm' WHERE pf.product_family_name = 'Heco Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ Wood and Drywall Screw') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as product_found, (SELECT pv.product_sku FROM product_families pf JOIN product_variants pv ON pf.product_family_id = pv.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp1 ON pv.product_sku = pvp1.product_sku AND pvp1.property_key = 'screw type' AND pvp1.property_value_text = 'wood screw' JOIN product_variant_properties pvp2 ON pv.product_sku = pvp2.product_sku AND pvp2.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp2.property_value_text = '6 mm' WHERE pf.product_family_name = 'Heco Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ Wood and Drywall Screw' LIMIT 1) as product_sku, (SELECT pv.record_path FROM product_families pf JOIN product_variants pv ON pf.product_family_id = pv.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp1 ON pv.product_sku = pvp1.product_sku AND pvp1.property_key = 'screw type' AND pvp1.property_value_text = 'wood screw' JOIN product_variant_properties pvp2 ON pv.product_sku = pvp2.product_sku AND pvp2.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp2.property_value_text = '6 mm' WHERE pf.product_family_name = 'Heco Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ Wood and Drywall Screw' LIMIT 1) as product_record_path;

WITH product AS (SELECT pv.product_sku FROM product_families pf JOIN product_variants pv ON pf.product_family_id = pv.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp1 ON pv.product_sku = pvp1.product_sku AND pvp1.property_key = 'screw type' AND pvp1.property_value_text = 'wood screw' JOIN product_variant_properties pvp2 ON pv.product_sku = pvp2.product_sku AND pvp2.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp2.property_value_text = '6 mm' WHERE pf.product_family_name = 'Heco Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ Wood and Drywall Screw' LIMIT 1) SELECT s.store_id, s.record_path, COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, 0) as available_today_quantity FROM stores s LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON s.store_id = si.store_id AND si.product_sku = (SELECT product_sku FROM product) WHERE s.city = 'Vienna';
